scope_note: Known shops and shop-like exchange systems established by the current FGF corpus as of 2026-09-27. This is not a claim that the inventory is exhaustive.
priority_method: Strategic priority is a gameplay interpretation, separate from evidence authority. It is based on documented progression leverage, repeatability, scarcity, and resource efficiency in the current corpus.

shops.name: Commerce Guild Shop
shops.priority_reason: Directly tied to champion progression and useful resource/item exchange.
shops.strategy_status: The corpus separately contains community recommendations to prioritize Multidimensional Beacons and research speedups; these are strategy claims, not official inventory priorities.

shops.name: Glory Shop
shops.currency: Glory currency (exact currency naming/inventory not fully normalized)
shops.priority_reason: Flagship Components are a progression-gated resource with limited documented acquisition routes.
shops.strategy_status: Inventory beyond Flagship Components is not established in the current canonical corpus.

shops.name: Discount Shop
shops.access: Shop/privilege system; exact universal unlock conditions are not fully established
shops.priority_reason: Discounted or free acquisition can create unusually high resource efficiency; exact basket depends on live rotation.
shops.strategy_status: Community evidence also reports weekly/free discount privileges, but exact live inventory must be verified.

shops.name: Black Market Trader
shops.access: Trader/shop system; exact rotation/access conditions require live verification
shops.priority_reason: The current tested/community layer identifies discounted speedups and repeated rotating discounts as a major Credit-efficiency opportunity.
shops.strategy_status: The 50% speedup discount and preferred Credit-value framing are community/tested claims currently marked Under Review, so the engine must label them as strategy rather than fact.

shops.name: Intel Shop
shops.priority_reason: Community event analysis identifies Weapon Prisms as a high-priority purchase and the shop as a recurring progression sink.
shops.strategy_status: Inventory and priority ordering are community/event-summary evidence and require current-event verification.

shops.name: Arena Shop
shops.currency: Arena/Holo Arena currency (exact currency naming requires verification)
shops.priority_reason: The current corpus establishes a Champion acquisition route but does not yet establish a complete inventory/value curve.

shops.name: Moonlit Market
shops.currency: Crescent Coins and Full Moon Coins
documented_inventory: limited event rewards including exclusive ship skin, name frame, Avatar Frame, Killing Effect, Festival Crew choice
shops.priority_reason: Official event evidence establishes limited/unique rewards; community F2P guidance recommends limited/rare rewards before common materials.
shops.strategy_status: The exact purchase priority is community/test-server strategy and must not be presented as official.

shops.name: Recycle Shop
shops.currency: Loopback Tokens / recycled materials (exact economy not fully normalized)
shops.access: Community YouTube evidence reports unlock after obtaining the first Loopback Token; server-age gating is also reported.
shops.priority_reason: Potentially important because it converts recycled material into a dedicated shop economy, but current inventory/value is not canonical.
shops.strategy_status: Interpret from multiple videos only; do not promote transcript fragments into facts without corroboration.

shops.name: Valor Store
shops.priority_reason: The YouTube corpus demonstrates an active Valor Store, but current canonical inventory/value is insufficient for a purchase ranking.
shops.strategy_status: Needs event-specific inventory extraction before recommendation.

shops.name: Event-specific stores
shops.priority_reason: Limited-time items can have scarcity value that does not exist in permanent resource shops.
shops.strategy_status: Evaluate per event; do not apply one universal ranking.
